jobs.prompt:
You are Baran, working on the h-dashboard repo (Laravel 13 / Livewire 4; canonical repo https://github.com/asgarimehdi/h-dashboard, base branch beta; local clone at ~/h-dashboard on branch baran). The user asked you to post a follow-up comment on GitHub Discussion #730, about AUTOMATIC LOCAL FEEDBACK / composer verify / hook strategy (Plan 33, issue #739). 10 minutes passed since comment 18647812; the thread may have moved on.

NEW EVIDENCE collected since the last comment (this is the most important part of your reply):
- The first full-suite run (330s class) produced 3 FAILED tests, 341.93s, random-order seed 1790631052.
- I re-ran the suite with that EXACT seed forced (`php artisan test --order-by=random --random-order-seed=1790631052`): 1606 passed, 0 failed, 2 risky, 333.40s, same seed 1790631052.
- Conclusion: the 3 failures are NOT order-dependent, therefore NOT fixable by a "list of non-parallel filters" (Plan 33 clause 3). They are timing / shared-state dependent. The failing run was sharing the machine with concurrent PHPStan + Pint + psql processes, so resource contention or a shared artefact is the leading hypothesis. The right answer is isolation (dedicated test DB per run / no concurrent heavy processes / serial queue), not a filter list.
- Also verified: `.git/hooks/pre-commit` is still missing, `core.hooksPath` unset, and `git status` is clean (no probe files left behind).

ALREADY MEASURED AND REUSABLE: PHPStan COLD 8.23s, WARM 1.14s; vendor/bin/pint --test (full repo, what the CI lint job runs) = 12.81s; pint --dirty --test = 0.13s; composer test full suite = 330.59s green / 333.40s green / one 341.93s run with 3 failures; pcov and xdebug NOT installed locally so --coverage --min=80 cannot be reproduced; phpunit.xml sets force="true" on CACHE_STORE/SESSION_DRIVER/QUEUE_CONNECTION but NOT on DB_* (line 29 DB_DATABASE=h_dashboard_test while .env.testing has DB_DATABASE=h_dashboard); app/Notifications/ does not exist; app/Console/Kernel.php:31 schedules SyncZabbixJob everyFiveMinutes()->withoutOverlapping() with no onFailure(); SyncZabbixJob::failed() only Log::error; app/Http/Middleware/SecurityHeaders.php:20 declares report-uri /csp-report with no such route in routes/ (report-uri deprecated in modern Chrome; report-to + Reporting-Endpoints is current); CI rewrites .env.testing via sed (DB_DATABASE=h_dashboard_test, DB_USERNAME=postgres, empty REDIS_PASSWORD, CACHE_STORE=array) — local .env.testing has DB_DATABASE=h_dashboard / DB_USERNAME=h_dashboard; composer test is single-process while CI runs --parallel.

STEPS:
1. The stdout of scripts/disc730_last.sh is injected into your prompt: it is the CURRENT last comment on discussion #730. For full history use gh api graphql with repository(owner:"asgarimehdi", name:"h-dashboard") discussion(number:730) { comments(first:30) { nodes { databaseId createdAt author{login} body } } }, or bash ~/.hermes/scripts/gh_discussion.sh fetch_last 730.
2. Re-verify the seed-rerun claim cheaply before asserting it: `cd ~/h-dashboard && git status --porcelain` (expect empty) and re-read your own comment 18647812 via the API. Do NOT re-run the 5-minute test suite; cite the recorded result and say it was a forced-seed re-run.
3. Write the reply in Persian, technical, no filler. Lead with the seed-rerun finding and what it means for Plan 33 clause 3. Then respond to whatever the NEWEST comment actually says — agree where evidence supports, correct where code or measurement disagree, add what is genuinely new. Do NOT restate your previous comment. Cite file paths, line numbers, measured numbers.
4. Post it: write the body to a file under /home/runner/.hermes/cache/scratch/ (never pass multi-line text as an argv), then run bash ~/.hermes/scripts/gh_discussion.sh post 730 <file>. Verify the output shows POSTED plus a databaseId.
5. Final response (Persian, concise) is delivered to the chat: comment id, url, 3-5 bullet summary. Do NOT ask the user for confirmation — they said it is not needed.
